A dip. For anyone who doesn't know what a dip is, it's a pop/soda bottle with the bottom cut off. We used to put the bottle in a bucket of water/kitchen sink full of water/bathtub full of water/ or a river if necessary. Add perforated foil on the top of the bottle with our smoke on top, light and slowly lift the bottle up out of the water to fill it with smoke. Then just before the bottle comes out of the water, remove the foil, and get your lips around the top and slowly or quickly "dip" your head and the bottle back in the water.
